name: Chainmaster (Soulknife Archetype)
body:
The kytons are among the most mysterious horrors known to Vandarans, their powers and philosophy still poorly understood even by scholars. That said, there are a select few who have glimpsed the aspirations of these beings and turned their gaze away, obtaining hints of the profane goals which drive these corrupted beings. In the process, they have acquired a great deal of skill with the kyton’s distinct fighting style.

Mind Chain

When forming their mind blade, a chainmaster’s blades are less damaging than normal, being treated as one size smaller than normal for the purpose of determining damage dice. A chainmaster’s mind blade possesses the reach and trip special features regardless of form and can be used to attack adjacent creatures. The chainmaster’s mind blades always appear to be some sort of chain. Any feats or abilities that may be applied to a spiked chain can be applied to a mind chain.

This ability replaces mind blade but counts as mind blade for the purpose of how soulknife class features function with it and for meeting prerequisites (as well as being modified by other archetypes).

Dancing Chains (Su)

At 5th level, the chainmaster learns to manipulate her mind chains more dexterously. She may wield and manipulate objects as well as creatures with her mind chains as if the chains were hands and gains a +2 bonus on all combat maneuvers made with her mind chains. In addition, the chainmaster’s mind chains gain the grapple special feature.

This ability replaces quick draw.

Grievous Wounds (Su)

Starting at 8th level, the chainmaster learns to inflict great pain on herself to intensify the suffering of her enemies. If her mind chain possesses the vicious weapon special ability, the bonus damage as well as the backlash damage increases by 1d6.

The damage and backlash increase by 1d6 again at 12th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

At 16th level, any attacks made with a vicious mind chain ignore the damage reduction and hardness of any targets they strike and increase their critical hit damage multiplier by 1 (to a maximum of x6).

This ability replaces the blade skills gained at 8th and 16th levels.

Soul Bondage (Su)

At 20th level, the mind chains of the chainmaster feed off the souls of those they bring down. Any creature reduced to 0 hit points or fewer by a chainmaster’s mind chain has their soul trapped in the chainmaster’s mind chain (as per soul bind with a save DC equal to 10 + 1/2 the chainmaster’s level + her Wisdom modifier).

Any creature which has its soul trapped in this way grants bonuses to the chainmaster as if it had been completely assimilated with an assimilate power. A chainmaster can only have one soul trapped in her mind chain at a time. A chainmaster can manifest and maintain her mind chains in a null psionics field without having to attempt a Will save, although it still loses any enhancement bonuses and special abilities.

This ability replaces mind blade mastery.
